Screens, new — Rich Docs

Organising pages

The page tree with richer rows, the gallery and recent views, filters, drag and drop and its touch alternatives, multi-select, the row menu with its dialogs, the Recycle bin, and the Docs space settings. Desktop is 1360, tablet 820, phone 390; menus become action sheets and dialogs become full-height sheets on a phone.
A
The page tree
Each row says what the page is: its icon or emoji, whether it is published, a draft, changed or may be outdated, how many child pages are inside, and whether AI suggestions wait. Desktop shows a cover card on hover; tablet and phone have no hover, so the same facts live in the gallery and in the row itself. Docs health and Ask the docs sit above the tree.

Rate limiting

Published · v15HMEdited by Hoa Mai · 2h ago

Overview

Every route counts requests per token in a sliding one-minute window. When a token goes over its limit the API answers 429 with a Retry-After header. See Auth for how tokens are issued.

Rate limits are not enforced yet. Tracked in KAN-12.

Limits

PlanRequests / minBurst
Free6010
Team60060
Business6,000600
# Over the limit the API answers 429
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12

{ "error": "rate_limited", "retry_in": 12 }

Rollout checklist

Publish the OpenAPI spec
Count requests per token KAN-9
Enforce on public endpoints KAN-12
Webhook retries KAN-31

C
Moving pages: drag, touch and select
Drag and drop reorders and re-parents. A line shows the place and the level; dropping on a page moves inside it; a closed page opens after a short hold. On touch a long-press lifts a row, and reorder mode gives handles and plain buttons for the same moves. Selecting several pages works the same way on every size.
